profile.headline: Mobile Software Engineer
profile.summary:
iOS DEVELOPER -
Software developer with a foundation in embedded systems, Java, and native mobile development. Experienced building everything from real-time drivers and 3D graphics engines to modern iOS and Android applications. Comfortable working across the full stack and across platforms — from low-level C/C++ to SwiftUI.

Specialties: SwiftUI, Metal, Java, C/C++, C#, SFDC

“There are two ways of constructing a software design: … Make it so simple that there are obviously no deficiencies, make it so complicated that there are no obvious deficiencies.” — Tony Hoare

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Independent mobile contractor specializing in iOS and Android development, using AI-assisted workflows to ship faster and more efficiently.

Currently developing an app on iOS and Android, that integrates with the client’s website enabling state health inspectors to conduct off-line inspections. (SwiftUI, iPadOS, Android, Compose, AWS)
positions.insights: Skills: Android Studio · MetalKit · Android Development · Analytical Skills · Embedded C · SwiftUI · Android Jetpack · Kotlin

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Team Lead
positions.description:
Developed cloud solutions in support of Verizon Connect's Global Sales and Finance teams. Promoted to Team Lead for the production Dev Tools Team. Verizon Connect provides GPS tracking and operations solutions for service fleets on four continents.

Developed Android software to provide global on-site installers, vehicle / tracking-unit pairing and validation.

Developed .Net operations software to provide internal and external users GPS unit and customer account management.

Developed Apex triggers in Salesforce.com (SFDC) for our sales team's CRM system. Trained at the Dreamforce developers' conference keeping current with the vendor's latest technologies.

Co-developed a RESTful ETL solution to migrate the company's active accounts from SFDC to its NetSuite ERP system providing better tracking of our customers, business financials, and operations.

Technologies: SaaS, REST, C#, .Net, Razor, jQuery, SFDC, Apex, Android, Swift, MS SQL, Python, Git.
positions.insights: Skills: Service-Level Agreements (SLA) · Technical Leadership · Code Review · IPC · Problem Solving · Apex Programming · DevOps · Communication · Analytical Skills · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Key Performance Indicators · Microservices · Information Science · Microsoft Azure · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Database Administration

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Assigned to Pega’s Bugatti core engine team. Pega is the leading provider of BPM software. Bugatti is tasked with maximizing PRPC runtime performance and to ensure high availability. Contributions:

• Developed a UI to enable/disable server-side tracing a user’s activity and to download the results. (Java, MBeans, JMX, JavaScript, JSP)
• Optimized engine-generated Java by using PMD to generate code that avoids auto-chaining built-in rules. (Java, PMD)
• Served as Scrum Master, conducting planning meetings and daily stand ups, presenting Sprint Reviews to project management, and representing the team at the bi-weekly Scrum of Scrums. (Scrum, Agile)
• Optimized PRPC to enable rules to query for an object’s existence in the system database without reading its BLOB. (Java)
• Developed scripts to analyze database optimization logs. (Java, awk)
positions.insights: Skills: Code Review · IPC · Problem Solving · Communication · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Team Lead
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer assigned to the Comcast Automated Test System (CATS) tools development team.

As an Embedded Java developer at GuideWorks developed the Integrated Search and Browse UI for Comcast's next generation OpenCable set top box.  [Java, OCAP, Embedded Linux]
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Leadership · Code Review · IPC · Problem Solving · Communication · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed an ORM-based API to capture simulation results using MySQL and Apache Cayenne (open source "Hibernate") for CRA's space surveillance research. [Java]
•	Developed Fence Search simulation for an AEGIS and UEWR radar study to detect incoming short-range and ICBM missiles. [Java]
positions.insights: Skills: Code Review · Problem Solving · Analytical Skills · Embedded C · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP)

projects.title: Digit Fidget
projects.description:
On the Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/digit-fidget/id6740449159

Digit Fidget is an iOS app that was developed using MetalKit technology. It's a simple (but curiously engaging) app which simulates a digit from the road side bank clocks of the past.
